t: Cancellation of Certificates of Sale — The deed executed on the 19th day of June, 1928, between California Pacific Title and Trust Co. (a corporation) and the City and County of San Francisco (a municipal corporation) to lands for opening of a street as shown…

Extensions of Time — Christensen Carson Co. is hereby granted an extension of ninety days' time from and after June 26, 1928, within which to complete the improvement of Faith street between San Bruno avenue and HoUaday avenue…
635 (Second Series) approve a map showing the opening of Balhi court; now, therefore, be it Resolved, That the map showing the opening of Balhi court be and the same is hereby approved.
